thesis: The speaker argues that the current macroeconomic backdrop is unprecedented due to the sudden stoppage of a broad swath of the global economy and unsustainable levels of debt across households, corporations, and governments. Consequently, the firm has pivoted to own businesses with net cash and reasonable leverage, refusing to liquidate well-run companies at market lows to buy back over-levered ones, while noting that many desirable durable businesses are currently too expensive to purchase.
